dm_single:
سلام! مرسی که کامنت گذاشتی 😊

5 پرامپت روش فاینمن با هوش مصنوعی 👇
جای [topic] موضوع خودت رو بنویس.

1. توضیح بده:
"I'm learning [topic]. I'll explain it in simple words. Act like a curious 12-year-old and ask me 3 'why' questions about my explanation."
2. جای خالی رو پیدا کن:
"Here is my explanation of [topic]: [paste]. List the gaps, mistakes and vague parts. Don't rewrite it, just point them out."
3. ساده‌ترش کن:
"Find the jargon in my explanation and ask me to replace each term with everyday words or an analogy."
4. امتحان بده:
"Quiz me on [topic] with 5 questions, one at a time, easy to hard. Wait for my answer each time."
5. مرور فردا:
"Give me a 5-point checklist of what my explanation of [topic] must include, so I can test myself tomorrow."

روش فاینمن: subjectguides.york.ac.uk/study-revision/feynman-technique
